#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;
const LL mod = 1e9 + 7;

LL modpow(LL a, LL b) {
    LL res = 1;
    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = res * a % mod;
        a = a * a % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<vector<int>> p(n + 1, vector<int>(n + 1));
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            cin >> p[i][j];
        }
    }
    
    // For n <= 6, we can use inclusion-exclusion over all permutations
    // Probability that a perfect matching exists = sum_{permutation} prob(matching exists) - overlaps...
    // But easier: use DP over subsets of right side
    
    vector<vector<LL>> dp(1 << n, vector<LL>(n + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); mask++) {
        int cnt = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        if (cnt >= n) continue;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (mask & (1 << j)) continue;
            LL prob = p[cnt + 1][j + 1] * modpow(100, mod - 2) % mod;
            dp[mask | (1 << j)][cnt + 1] = (dp[mask | (1 << j)][cnt + 1] + dp[mask][cnt] * prob) % mod;
        }
    }
    
    cout << dp[(1 << n) - 1][n] << '\n';
    return 0;
}
